documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Sorrel Holdings (fictional).
In this document "SHH" means Sorrel Holdings. Sorrel Holdings reports net debt of $332.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Sorrel Holdings reports available liquidity of $71.2m on a reported basis. Sorrel Holdings: capital expenditure for FY2025 on a reported basis — not provided. Sorrel Holdings reports revenue of $422.3m for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Sorrel Holdings, the permitted acquisitions basket is read as: capped at the greater of $15m and 20% of EBITDA.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Sorrel Holdings (fictional).
Sorrel Holdings reports net debt of $283.8m for FY2024 on a adjusted (management definition) basis. Sorrel Holdings reports available liquidity of $59.7m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Sorrel Holdings reports cash margin of 6.2% for FY2024. Sorrel Holdings reports interest cover of 1.603x for FY2024. For Sorrel Holdings, the permitted acquisitions basket is read as: uncapped where pro forma leverage stays below 4.0x.
